cost_scope: Checkpoint training sum excludes backup/preparation; elapsed summary is the full successful attempt.

identity.d1_semantics: All seen optimization-eligible TRAIN; common stopping/calibration held out; offline reference
identity.d2_semantics: Current attack quota includes optimization and stopping slots; both are subsampled

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aimagelab/mammoth/e75a491c69fd729edeb01431afb753d9157d9a81/models/config/derpp.yaml (seq-cifar100, buffer500); transferred fixed coefficients, not NIDS-tuned

identity.scope: RQ2 diagnostic only; no changes to S1/R1-R5 or locked RQ1/RQ3

publication_scope: Post-hoc §181 RQ2 diagnostics only. No new candidate or change to S1/R1-R5/RQ1/RQ3.
semantics_limitations: D1 revisits all seen optimization-eligible TRAIN, with common calibration/stopping held out; it is an offline reference, not a guaranteed numerical upper bound.
D2 matches current attack optimization and stopping counts to the split memory quota, so it changes stopping sample size as well as optimization exposure.
D3 scales total memory before integer allocation; old samples can shrink but cannot be replenished.
Differences from AR-Stateless are diagnostic evidence, not proof of intrinsic class inseparability.
